headline: Instagram limits reach of undisclosed AI profiles
summary: The platform is renaming its 'AI creator' label to 'AI-generated profile' and will penalize accounts that don't properly disclose AI-generated people.
details: Instagram announced a new policy to address the growing prevalence of AI-generated profiles. The platform is changing its existing 'AI creator' label to 'AI-generated profile' to make disclosures clearer.

This new label signifies that the person featured on the profile was generated or substantially created using AI. Creators who fail to properly label such profiles may face reduced reach on the platform.

Accounts that adhere to the new labeling policy will not be penalized for featuring AI-generated individuals. The label is not intended for standard AI use, such as photo editing, caption polishing, or graphic creation.

The change comes in response to user feedback, as many have expressed discomfort upon discovering that profiles appearing human are, in fact, AI-generated. Instagram aims to increase transparency and user trust.

Concerns about AI-generated content have been mounting, with AI influencers appearing on various social media platforms. Previous reports highlighted AI doctors and influencers promoting products, raising ethical questions.
This announcement follows a previous backlash Instagram faced over an AI tool that allowed users to generate images using others' likenesses without explicit consent, a feature Meta later removed.
